_meta.purpose: The new constitution, as a four-step track. The 8 February 2026 referendum approved drafting one (60.16% yes, 69.65% turnout). Chapters 1 and 2 are not on the table. Bhumjaithai tables nothing radical: the furthest any part goes is a moderate reformist tilt.
_meta.stances: Party and Senate stance on each position, -2 (opposes) to +2 (supports). Positions are ordered from least to most reformist; `score` is the reform score.
_meta.vote: Each changed clause goes to a joint sitting: yes >= 351 of 700 and at least 67 of 200 senators. A clause that fails reverts to the current text.

positions.label: Keep
positions.text: The 2024 self-selection system and every current power.

positions.label: Adjust
positions.text: Selection kept, but the candidate groups are opened up and block voting is banned.

positions.label: Tilt
positions.text: Selection kept. The Senate loses its one-third veto over constitutional amendments.
400 constituency seats and 100 party-list seats, two ballots.
Ten constituencies become list seats. Applies at the next general election.
Twenty-five constituencies become list seats. Still parallel, not MMP. Applies at the next general election.

positions.label: Keep
positions.text: The Court and its power to dissolve parties, unchanged.

positions.label: Adjust
positions.text: The panel that selects judges is widened, with one member nominated by the opposition.

positions.label: Tilt
positions.text: Dissolving a party needs a two-thirds vote of the Court.

positions.label: Keep
positions.text: Governors appointed by the Interior Ministry.

positions.label: Adjust
positions.text: Elected-governor pilot in Chiang Mai, Phuket and Khon Kaen.

positions.label: Tilt
positions.text: Pilot in ten provinces, and a modestly larger local share of revenue.

positions.label: Paternalist
positions.text: The Singapore model. Duties sit beside rights: public order, social harmony, responsible expression. The state gains wider powers over assembly and online content.

positions.label: Adjust
positions.text: Community rights over land and the environment.

positions.label: Tilt
positions.text: Community rights, and a constitutional right to government information.
